items.title: General Motors Third-Quarter Vehicle Sales Fall 5.5%
items.summary: Discontinued models and a diminished market for electric vehicles weighed on the automaker’s performance in the third quarter.

items.title: Which Automaker Stock Dominated in September: Tesla, Ford, or General Motors?
items.summary: Three automakers faced the same September market, yet one of them broke sharply from the pack while the other two suffered painful double-digit losses. Find out which company defied a brutal month for consumer stocks and what that split signals for investors.

items.title: Ford’s Sales Hit Alarming Drop
